headline: Armed men abducted 20 police recruits of the Kalat Police Training Centre in Balochistan's Mastung district, officials said.

card.desc: Armed men stopped their van; search operation underway.

caption:
Armed men abducted 20 police recruits from the Kalat Police Training Centre in Balochistan's Mastung district, Dawn and Arab News reported, citing officials. Dawn said security forces have launched a search in nearby mountains, and no group has claimed responsibility.
